en.text:
While Airborne with at least one full Melee Charge, pressing [Air Move] activates <strand/>Weavewalk and consumes 20% Melee Ability Energy.

While <strand/>Weavewalk is active, your Melee Energy drains at a rate of 25% per second, and you generate a Perched <strand/>Threadling every 0.5 seconds.

<strand/>Weavewalk grants 90% Damage Resistance against Combatants and Players, and functionally grants the effects of <void/>Void Invisibility, preventing enemy combatants from engaging you.

You are unable to interact with the world while <strand/>Weavewalk is active. This includes reviving other Players, collecting ammo bricks, or picking up Orbs of Power. <strand/>Threadlings, <arc/>Arc Souls, and <yellow No Time To Explain's 'Time-Slip Portal' /> deal 50% decreased damage while <strand/>Weavewalk is active. 

Exiting <strand/>Weavewalk grants <strand/>Woven Mail based on the duration it was active, granting 2 to 20 seconds of <strand/>Woven Mail.
